import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sleep_disorders = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in sleep_disorders.unique():
    mask = sleep_disorders == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'Sleep Duration'], 
               df.loc[mask, 'Quality of Sleep'],
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=disorder)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Physical Activity Level vs Stress Level (heatmap-style)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Create bins for better visualization
df_temp = df.copy()
df_temp['Activity_Bin'] = pd.cut(df_temp['Physical Activity Level'], bins=5)
df_temp['Stress_Bin'] = pd.cut(df_temp['Stress Level'], bins=5)
pivot_data = df_temp.groupby(['Activity_Bin', 'Stress_Bin']).size().reset_index(name='count')
activity_labels = [f'{int(i.left)}-{int(i.right)}' for i in df_temp['Activity_Bin'].cat.categories]
stress_labels = [f'{int(i.left)}-{int(i.right)}' for i in df_temp['Stress_Bin'].cat.categories]
pivot_matrix = pivot_data.pivot_table(values='count', 
                                       index='Activity_Bin', 
                                       columns='Stress_Bin', 
                                       fill_value=0)
sns.heatmap(pivot_matrix, annot=True, fmt='g', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax2, cbar_kws={'label': 'Count'})
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level Ranges', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Physical Activity Ranges', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticklabels(stress_labels, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.set_yticklabels(activity_labels, rotation=0)

# 3. BMI Category distribution with Sleep Quality
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
bmi_data = []
labels = []
for cat in bmi_present:
    bmi_data.append(df[df['BMI Category'] == cat]['Quality of Sleep'].values)
    labels.append(cat)
bp = ax3.boxplot(bmi_data, labels=labels, patch_artist=True, notch=True)
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(labels)))
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Sleep Quality Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate colored by Age groups
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['Age_Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 100], 
                          labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
for age_group in df['Age_Group'].cat.categories:
    mask = df['Age_Group'] == age_group
    ax4.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'Daily Steps'], 
               df.loc[mask, 'Heart Rate'],
               alpha=0.6, s=70, label=age_group)
ax4.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Age Group', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
